en.backup.hint: This folder holds the version-history directory and the “Export to backup folder” target, and keeps one extra memory.json.bak. The store file itself (and its cross-process lock) never moves. It is machine-local and is not carried to another machine by an export.
en.backup.label: Custom backup location (absolute path; empty = next to the store file)
en.backup.multiDevice: Multi-device tip: point this at a local cloud-sync folder and let only the export files and history snapshots sync. Do not sync the store directory itself — two machines writing at once would overwrite each other.
en.batch.confirmDelete: Delete the {count} selected entries? This cannot be undone.
en.batch.noneSelected: Tick the entries to act on first
en.batch.tagInputPlaceholder: Tags to add (separate several with commas)
en.batch.tagPrompt: Enter tags to add to {count} entries (separate several with commas)
en.budget.label: Injection size limit (characters)
en.budget.note: Characters, not tokens: with DeepSeek tokenization roughly 1 Chinese character ≈ 0.6 token (English ≈ 0.3), the {max}-character ceiling is about {tokens} tokens; actual usage depends on the model.
en.budget.omitted: {count} active entries are not injected this turn because the limit is exceeded; raise the limit or adjust priorities
en.budget.rangeError: The limit must be between {min} and {max}
en.budget.unitHint: The unit is characters, not tokens
en.budget.used: {used} of {budget} characters actually injected (≈{tokens} tokens, estimate)
en.confirm.unavailable: This shell cannot show a confirmation dialog, so the action was cancelled and nothing changed.
en.diag.copyManual: Automatic copy is unavailable; select and copy the text below manually.
en.diag.hostWarn: Security notice: the settings route is bound to a non-loopback address ({host}); other devices on the same network can reach this page without authentication. Do not expose it on an untrusted network — for public deployments read “Publishing behind a reverse proxy” in the README.
en.diag.pulls: Prompt pulls (counted since this plugin started)
en.editor.confirmDiscard: The draft has unsaved changes. Discard them?
en.editor.contentPlaceholder: e.g. Always answer in Simplified Chinese; ask before acting when the requirement is unclear.
en.editor.hint: Takes effect for the next conversation turn once saved
en.editor.modeAuto: On demand (the model judges by relevance)
en.editor.needTitleOrContent: Fill in at least a title or the instruction content
en.editor.title: Title
en.editor.when: Applicable scenarios (optional; helps the model decide when it applies)
en.editor.whenPlaceholder: e.g. When writing or modifying code
en.err.timeout: Host request timed out (no response for 15 s)
en.err.unrecognized: The host returned data this panel cannot recognize
en.export.failed: Export failed: the host returned unrecognized data
en.feedback.bodyPlaceholder: Steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result; for a suggestion, describe the use case
en.feedback.contactPlaceholder: Email / WeChat / GitHub handle so the maintainer can reply
en.feedback.errBodyLong: The description must be at most {max} characters
en.feedback.errContact: The contact must be at most {max} characters
en.feedback.errTitleLong: The title must be at most {max} characters
en.feedback.failed: Could not send the feedback. Please try again later.
en.feedback.hint: The mail automatically includes the plugin version, DSH / Node versions and platform — never your instruction content.
en.feedback.intro: Found a problem or have a suggestion? Send it to the plugin maintainer by email with the form below.
en.feedback.timeout: Timed out waiting for the host ({seconds} s). The mail may already have been sent — check before retrying.
en.feedback.titlePlaceholder: Sum up the problem or suggestion in one line
en.history.deleteConfirm: Delete this snapshot? This cannot be undone.
en.history.empty: No snapshots yet (the first save creates one).
en.history.itemMetaLite: {size} KB (file too large to count items)
en.history.restoreConfirm: Roll the whole memory back to the snapshot from {time} (rev {rev})? The current content stays in memory.json.bak, and the rollback itself creates a new snapshot, so you can roll forward again.
en.history.subtitle: Every save leaves a timestamped snapshot ({max} kept per device, oldest evicted first). Review them here and roll back with one click.
en.import.notJson: The import file is not valid JSON ({detail})
en.import.tooLarge: This file is about {size} MB, far beyond what this plugin can import (keep it within about {limit} MB). Make sure you selected a JSON file produced by Export.
en.list.empty: No instructions yet. Click “＋ New instruction” to add your first one, e.g. “Always answer in Simplified Chinese”.
en.list.filteredEmpty: No instructions match the current filters.
en.mute.hint: While paused, neither instructions nor personas are injected. It resumes automatically and survives a restart.
en.panel.subtitle: Saved instructions are written into the system prompt and apply to every conversation, answer, and task that follows.
en.panel.title: Instruction Memory
en.preview.label: What the system prompt receives on every turn
en.profiles.chars: Active personas total {count} characters (separate from the instruction budget; injected in full, never trimmed)
en.profiles.confirmDelete: Delete the persona “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
en.profiles.contentPlaceholder: Describe yourself, e.g. 8 years of backend experience, so skip intro concepts; prefers the conclusion first, then actionable steps, no small talk.
en.profiles.empty: No persona yet. Click “＋ New persona” to add facts about yourself; with no persona ticked, the AI answers exactly as it normally would.
en.profiles.name: Persona name
en.profiles.namePlaceholder: e.g. Professional background / Communication style / Personality / Goals
en.profiles.subtitle: Facts about you: background, tastes, personality and goals. When “Use this persona” is ticked, the AI adjusts depth, examples and advice to tilt toward you — while staying correct and on-topic; it must never change facts or wander off the question to please you.
en.restore.confirm: Replace the whole memory with the selected backup file? The current content stays in memory.json.bak and in the version history; sets, instructions and personas are all replaced by the file (machine-local settings such as the backup location are kept).
en.restore.hint: Replace the whole memory with an exported backup file (import only merges, so it cannot restore a whole store)
en.rules.label: How instructions apply
en.rules.note: “Always” applies unconditionally; “On demand” lets the model judge by relevance. When the limit is exceeded, higher-priority entries are kept and the rest are skipped.
en.search.placeholder: Search instructions: title / content / scenario ({count} in total)
en.section.label: Instruction Memory
en.sets.deleteActive: The active set cannot be deleted; switch to another set first.
en.sets.deleteConfirm: Delete the set “{name}”? Its {entries} instructions and {profiles} personas are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
en.sets.draftsClosed: The editor draft open before the switch was closed
en.sets.note: Split memory into independent sets (e.g. Work / Personal / a client). Only the active set is injected; switching changes what is injected and never moves or deletes any text.
en.sets.switchHint: Switch to this set: the injected content changes immediately
en.sim.disclaimer: A local preview is NOT the model’s actual judgement: it only matches literal keywords against each on-demand rule’s scenario/title/content to help you sharpen the scenario field and predict trade-offs. It does not take part in injection and says nothing about whether the model would actually follow the rule.
en.sim.hint: Type a task description to list the on-demand rules with the strongest literal overlap; the result is for your own inspection.
en.sim.none: No on-demand rule overlaps this description literally.
en.sim.noWhen: No scenario text — consider adding one
en.sim.omitted: Not injected this round (over the size limit)
en.sim.onlyAuto: Only on-demand rules take part in the preview; always-on rules apply unconditionally and are unaffected by this result.
en.sim.placeholder: Describe the current task, e.g. help me edit this config file
en.sim.summary: {total} on-demand rules, {hit} with a literal match
en.sim.title: Local preview of on-demand rules
en.sort.label: Sort
en.sort.title: By title
en.source.editorOpen: Close the open entry/persona editor before entering source mode
en.source.keepDraft: The save was refused and your draft is intact; fix it and retry, or click “Reload latest” to discard local edits.
en.source.notObject: The top level must be a JSON object
en.source.reloadConfirm: Reloading discards the source draft you are editing. Continue?
en.source.subtitle: Edit the whole store file (identical to memory.json). Saving runs the same validation and disclosures as a hand edit, carries rev conflict protection, and takes effect immediately.
en.source.truncatedInput: The source is very long ({size}0k characters); live validation is paused. Saving still enforces the limit.
en.status.mounted: Mounted into the system prompt — effective for every turn that follows ({chars} chars)
en.storage.migrated: Migrated from the old location: {path} (the original is kept as *.migrated)
en.tag.omittedTitle: This entry currently stays out of the system prompt because the injection size limit is exceeded
en.tag.truncatedTitle: This entry is too long; only its beginning reaches the system prompt
en.tags.hint: Up to {max} tags per entry, each at most {len} characters
en.tags.label: Tags (optional; used only for grouping/filtering on this page, never injected)
en.tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter; separate several with commas, e.g. code-style
